Hi Kimberly,

Hope you're well — FinBridge is running a routine vendor security and dataflow review ahead of our contract renewal. To complete our checklist we need a single, consolidated worksheet that lists all subprocessors that may process EU personal data, the country of processing, data categories, and whether onshore fallback or escrow options exist.

Can you provide that worksheet plus any shortnotes on recent subprocessor changes (last 12 months)? A downloadable spreadsheet or a Drive link works. Ideally we'd get this by next Friday (2026-09-10) so procurement can finalize the packet for our InfoSec review.

Thanks,

Kimberly — taking this on. A few quick notes while I start filling the sheet:

- EdgeFlow (analytics relay) has been added in 2026-03 as a transient processor for telemetry; primary processing is in IE and DE, no US egress for EU tenants. Covered under our DPA (Annex B), retention 30 days for metrics.
- CacheWave (edge cache) moved a portion of logs to onshore EU storage last quarter; I'll mark "onshore fallback: yes" and include the contact for auditor requests.
- We have one temporary vendor (CloudMirror) used for a migration window in 2025-11 — I'll flag as temporary with dates and provide evidence of deletion after the window.

I'll attach a short evidence bundle (S3 policy snapshot and access list) when I push the sheet.
